wiki_catalogs.name: Project Overview
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for this React Native mobile game application overview. Explain the project's purpose as an interactive pixel art game with hero management, time-based mechanics, and artifact systems. Document the target platforms (iOS/Android), key features including hero ceremonies, resurrection gameplay, inventory management, and NFC integration. Describe the overall architecture using React Native with TypeScript, component-based structure, and state management patterns. Include technology stack details, system requirements, and high-level feature descriptions that help both beginners understand what the app does and experienced developers grasp the technical foundation.

wiki_catalogs.name: Hero System
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive documentation for the hero management system. Detail hero creation, customization options, stat calculations, and lifecycle events including birth, growth, and death. Document hero ceremony mechanics, progression systems, and relationship with other game elements. Include data models for hero profiles, stat definitions, and state transitions. Provide examples of hero creation workflows, stat modifications, and integration with UI components.

wiki_catalogs.name: State Management Architecture

Explain the centralized store pattern, action dispatching mechanism, and how game state is managed across different screens and components. Document the relationship between actions, reducers, and state updates. Include examples of how game events trigger state changes and how components subscribe to state updates. Detail the type definitions and contracts that ensure data consistency throughout the application.

Explain how it handles app launch logic, device capability detection, and routing to appropriate screens based on user state. Include prop interfaces, lifecycle methods, and integration with the global state management. Detail any animations, loading states, or conditional rendering patterns used.

Detail the NFC reading and writing capabilities, card format specifications, and data serialization patterns. Document the card detection lifecycle, error handling for failed reads/writes, and permission requirements across different platforms. Include examples of reading hero data from NFC cards, writing game state to cards, and handling card removal events. Cover security considerations for data integrity and authentication. Provide troubleshooting guidance for common NFC issues like reader compatibility and signal strength problems.
